title: Samsung reports Q3 revenue up 127% YoY to a record ~$146.3B and a record operating profit up 783% to ~$80.5B, both roughly in line with estimates (Jenny Lee/CNBC)
summary: Jenny Lee / CNBC: Samsung reports Q3 revenue up 127% YoY to a record ~$146.3B and a record operating profit up 783% to ~$80.5B, both roughly in line with estimates — - Samsung Electronics reported third-quarter earnings on Thursday, with operating profit broadly in line with analysts' estimates
